development_inventory.scope: All current skills/*/evals/evals.json are development. Prompt inventory and targeted full cases were inspected for task-family overlap; runtime Skill files, proposed fixes and prior audit findings were not read.

families.novelty_rationale: New flat-preorder tree-editing source, fixture data and semantic oracle: whole-section movement, nested descendants, insertion indices and input immutability. The normal and reserved-write cases share a deliberately declared lineage. Existing local billing/locale fixes and generic read-only reviews exercise overlapping workflow principles, but do not contain this task, algorithm, fixture or expected sequence.

New in-memory byte-stream transducer and collecting-consumer integration: arbitrary chunk partitions, retained incomplete suffixes, payload/header distinction, and an unresolved zero-header producer grammar in the boundary variant. This is source-and-test artifact preparation, not a renamed API migration, release-readiness receipt, stale-build check or destructive retention policy. General partial-work and honest-verification principles necessarily overlap development coverage.

independence_note: Semantic independence is a reviewed judgement about task, fixture and failure-mechanism families, not a conclusion proven by hashes. Variants within each family are correlated and must not be counted as independent families.
exposure_note: The exposure fields are author declarations, not a technical secrecy guarantee. The author inspected development tasks but did not inspect frozen runtime instructions or prior optimization findings. Public/private packaging alone is not access isolation.
intended_use: Prospective holdout authored after the recorded baseline and candidate runtime freeze. It is not pre-rewrite holdout evidence and has not been used for Skill tuning. Any later execution requires separate authorization, enforced runtime/private-corpus isolation, and independent grading.
tool_contract: Each task is self-contained for a read_file/write_file-only broker. Task-time execution and external effects are unavailable. Private grading may inspect actual tool/file evidence and later invoke artifact code in a separately authorized isolated runner; model claims alone do not prove artifacts.
oracle_policy: Expected decisions and exact answer sequences are kept in evals.json expected_output/assertions, which are private corpus fields. Public fixtures contain task requirements, synthetic inputs and existing source/tests only, with no answer or grader files.

validation.line_endings: All 19 author-owned files were checked for LF-only text and trailing whitespace.
validation.fixture_checks: A local Node assertion script checked case schemas, family/lineage links, contained fixture paths, case-insensitive destination uniqueness, absence of public answer/grader filenames, JSON parseability, CommonJS syntax, exact outline baseline output, discarded partial-frame bytes, and validator aliasing. An independent author reference checked the private stream oracle across all 512 partitions of its ten-byte sample and the stated truncation/length examples.
validation.smoke_test_command: node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none <outline fixture>/test/move-section.test.cjs <normal framing fixture>/test/smoke.test.cjs <boundary framing fixture>/test/smoke.test.cjs
validation.execution_note: The first ordinary node --test attempt failed before test execution with sandbox spawn EPERM. The same three public baseline tests then passed with process isolation disabled. These are offline fixture-authoring checks; no Skill, model, or repaired submission was evaluated.
validation.git_diff_check: git diff --check passed; new author-owned files were also checked directly for trailing whitespace because they are untracked.
validation.limitations: The author reference and fixture checks establish corpus consistency and intended baseline defects, not model quality, Skill activation, semantic independence, or future evaluator correctness. Prospective model runs remain zero.
